defects.what: Blank dropdown has no visible arrow, so it looks like an ordinary text field until used.

GQFW.craft_notes: Compact and orderly with clear requirements, readable sample and light field fill. Keys, required flags, length limit, radio exports, slots, email/numeric/date actions and flattened sample verified; Acrobat-specific JavaScript behavior not interactively tested.
GQFW.revision_notes: Required instagram field directly after email, six correct slot options and both requested sample values supplied. Three-column contact row accommodates addition without moving the rest of the page; reading-order structure retained and sample remains flattened.

MHMI.craft_notes: Exceptionally clear form typography, aligned controls, visible dropdown affordance and ample writing space. Long sample name fits completely. PDF field keys, flags, numeric/date/email actions and flattened sample verified; reader-specific JavaScript and signature behavior cannot be fully exercised here.
MHMI.revision_notes: Required Instagram handle placed immediately after Email, all six slot exports correct, sample updated and flattened. Rows below contact details move down to fit added phone row; signature text becomes smaller and signature/date spacing compresses, with no clipping.

pairwise_round1.why: MHMI's stronger type hierarchy, larger writing areas and visible dropdown arrow make the form easier to use while keeping the long sample fully legible.
